title: Bounded internal sparse tensor contract
primary_claim: A small standard-library-only typed sparse tensor view can represent algorithm-facing coordinates over one exact Fourfold/Forest pair without becoming a fifth semantic plane, graph authority, store, registry, scheduler, evaluator, or promotion surface.
acceptance: input axis, label, coordinate, evidence and entry order does not change canonical identity
digest is stable across Python hash seeds
duplicate coordinate/relation claims refuse rather than last-write-wins
unknown labels, incomplete coordinates, duplicate axis coordinates and non-finite values refuse
partial and absent projections retain explicit reasons; complete projections cannot carry an incompleteness reason
source revision and both canonical source digests are bound through ContractProvenance
named sparse slicing and deterministic integer coordinate projection are covered
construction has explicit finite axis, label and entry ceilings
no existing production file or public registry is modified
requested_verification: PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python -m pytest -q tests/twin/test_tensor_kernel.py tests/twin/test_fourfold_contracts.py tests/twin/test_projection_verifier.py

verification.claim: Source and focused tests are prepared; no green test or package claim is made until an executor records the commands on the exact head.

deletion_or_fold_conditions: Delete this module if equal-budget experiments show no measurable value over direct Fourfold/Forest queries.
Fold it into an existing canonical Twin contract if that contract gains the same sparse computational view without creating a second identity.
Do not add NumPy, PyTorch, a vector database, or another backend until a measured workload justifies an adapter and replacement path.
Do not activate Tensor-to-Fourfold conversion work until this experiment is reviewed and its source identity semantics survive adversarial tests.
residual_limits: This packet does not define conversion from Fourfold/Forest; that is a separate dependent experiment.
It does not benchmark speed, memory, retrieval quality, model quality, CrewAI, or AlphaEvolve.
The Python tuple representation is a correctness contract, not a claim of numerical-kernel performance.
No Gate-2 authority is inferred from this Gate-1-contained experiment.
rollback: Close the draft PR and delete the experiment branch after retaining review/evidence; no existing production file requires reversal.
